name: snote: Simplenote in your terminal
author: qteamdon
description: Unofficial keyboard-driven client for Automattic's Simplenote, in your terminal. Browse, search and write notes, and send one to your Skryf blog as a draft. A bar button installs the pre-built app on first click: no build step. Needs Node.js 22 or newer already on your machine; setup stops with a one-line hint if it is missing.

barWidget.description: Open or focus snote, an unofficial Simplenote client, from the bar. Installs the pre-built app the first time.
